text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen has finally arrived. 
Mejiro Dober catches her breath at how 
flawlessly conditioned the Senior-class 
contenders look.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Air Groove appears before 
Mejiro Dober, exuding an overwhelming aura 
of intimidation as she delivers a brief 
pep talk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Refusing to be overwhelmed, Mejiro Dober 
stands her ground. The final decisive 
battle of the Classic era begins—
